messages.subject: Project Umbra - AtlasMRV patent family verification
messages.plaintextBody:
Alan,

We're licensing the AtlasMRV patent family exclusively to Hollencroft. Could you verify the family against the registers and give us a validity + FTO confirmation we can rely on at signing? Draft schedule attached - GB2598471 and GB2611902 plus EP/US equivalents. Note the Mehl co-inventor assignment on GB2611902.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
